sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Players with the "Left Behind" or "Standard" game editions start with this container.
  - If the container is left in the pouch slot upon upgrading to a game version that comes with a bigger one, it will be removed and replaced.
- Can only fit:
  - Document case
  - Dogtag case
  - Gingy keychain
  - Injector case
  - Key tool
  - Keycard holder case
  - S I C C organizational pouch
  - Simple wallet
  - WZ Wallet
  - Loot
  - Provisions
  - Meds
  - Keys, Keycards & Maps
  - Weapon mods (Besides magazines, special scopes and some mounts)
  - Armor plates
  - Currency
  - Armbands
  - Earpieces
  - Vanity Face cover
  - Vanity Headwear
  - Vanity Eyewear
  - Melee weapons
  - Special equipment

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References: The Secure container Alpha is closely modeled after the real life case called the iM2050 Storm Case by Pelican. The only differences between the real life counterpart and the in-game model is the handle type.
- In the early stages of game development, the Alpha Container used to be green.
